runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
The documents I searched don't set a fine for missing the AI strategy deadline. OMB M-25-21 does set the deadline itself. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications. The memo also says that strategies must use the AI Strategies template, to be provided by 0MB, and make their AI Strategies publicly available.

None of the passages I retrieved describe a monetary penalty or any other sanction for a late strategy. The closest consequence in the memo applies to high-impact AI that is not performing at an appropriate level. In that case, agencies must have a plan to discontinue its use until actions are taken to achieve compliance with this memorandum. If proper risk mitigation is not possible, agencies must cease the use of the AI. That is a use restriction for specific AI systems, not a penalty for missing the strategy deadline.

My searches covered the memo's deadlines and requirements, but I did not read the full document, so I can't rule out a penalty clause elsewhere. If you have the full text or a specific section in mind, I can check it.
